title: John Harwood Interviews Rahm Emanuel on the Midterms, His Record, and Democrats’ Future
author: John Harwood
content:
On the eve of the midterm election, Democrats are eyeing a potential sweep of
Congress. But is it possible?

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

**Rahm Emanuel** , a former senior aide for Clinton and Obama's White Houses,
who helped engineer a Democratic sweep of the House and Senate in 2006, joins
**Zeteo 's John Harwood** to weigh in. The two also go back and forth on...

  * Emanuel's controversial track record as Chicago mayor and Obama's chief of staff: **" If you're looking for perfection, look somewhere else."**

  * Cutting off military aid to Israel

  * How Democrats should go forward:** "On Nov. 3, the Republicans are going to lose... What we do in 2027 will determine whether we have won."**

  * His potential 2028 presidential ambitions

  * ...and more.
